newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil retreats as diesel supply grows.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil retreats as diesel supply grows.

text.p: NWE gas oil fell sharply on Thursday as speculative longs liquidated their positions on the IPE futures market, and physical market sentiment was also weak as buyers reported more supply from the United Steas and the Mediterranean.
IPE Nov gas oil slipped $5.25 to $220.50 per tonne by 1246 GMT, and the Dec Brent/gas oil crack spread fell about 50 cents to $5.25 per barrel.
"Heating oil is in a temporary lull between stock building and end-user demand," a trader said.
Heating oil barges from storage traded at Nov IPE +$1.50 for lifting until Nov 3, steady on Wednesday.
Diesel was under some pressure from U.S. arbitrage cargoes and three Algerians due to arrive in northern Europe shortly.
One was already sold, but one Algerian was on offer at Nov IPE +$22 cif Hamburg, and may end up in Bordeaux. Several buyers were reported in France and Germany, but mostly for 10,000 tonne lots.
